_comment: Lexigotchi contract deployment registry. Filled in after `forge script Deploy` (see the admin Launch tab). The admin dashboard reads this to light up the live on-chain operations; until an address is set, that contract's ops stay in transaction-plan mode. Addresses are public — commit this file once deployed. The operator can also paste addresses into the admin Deployments tab, which persists them in the browser for the current session.

shop._comment: The Shop (decisions.md #22), beside the suite: not in `contracts`, so a network can run the whole game without it (isSuiteDeployed reads `contracts`). `usdc` is Circle's USDC on Base mainnet (from Circle's docs) and MockUSDC on Base Sepolia.
